annotations.title: Pause, resume or retune a show

description: [Free] Changes a show's switch, cadence, caps or name, or moves it to another format or format version. The template itself is edited with update_format, which writes a new version and leaves every episode already made where it is. Nothing is rendered.

active.description: false pauses the show (the scheduler skips it, run_show refuses); true resumes it.

format_id.description: Move the show to another format of the same kind.

format_version.description: Pin the show to this version of its format.

format_version_latest.description: true unpins the show so it follows its format's latest version.

max_credits_per_day.description: A new daily credit cap (an episode is 40 credits).

repeat_every.description: query and watchlist shows: a new period, or none to stop repeating.

rotate_webhook_secret.description: webhook shows: mint a new signing secret (returned once in this call's webhook_secret); the old one stops working at once.

show_id.description: The show_id from create_show or list_shows.

source.description: query shows: a new source (same shape as create_show).

watchlist.description: watchlist shows: the new list; it replaces the old one. Items already made stay made.

name: update_show

recent_episodes.description: The five latest: episode_id, item_key, title, item_url, video_id, status, video_status, error, credits, format_version, provenance, created_at.
